- Total net sales: 152,669.0
- Operating income: 21,689.0
- Net income: 18,470.0
- Diluted earnings per share: 18.42
- Operating cash flow: 21,172.0

These are the audited figures on file. Diluted EPS 18.42 on net income 18,470 is the basis for valuation; at the current quote of 385.43 (bid 385.41 / ask 385.45) the shares trade at about 20.9x earnings, well inside the reasonable range for a quality retailer.
